title: Kitchen lamps (2/2)
body: Same again for the kitchen, plus one leftover question about the living room spots.

questions.question: Living room: where do the three Hue spots actually point — ceiling rail, over the couch, wall wash? And are they your main light or accent?
questions.placeholder: e.g. ceiling track over the seating area, main ceiling light

questions.question: Bowl (dimmable, no colour) — where is it, what does it light, how bright?
questions.placeholder: e.g. bowl lamp on the counter, warm and soft
